text: Food and drink, A1 ! Came on a Saturday night and there was about 30 min, which was definitely worth wait. After being seats I ordered green chile burritos and my boyfriend order the buffalo chx' quesadilla. My burrito was so good. Seasoned to perfection! My boyfriend enjoyed his meal as well. My friend thing was the drinks tho ! I loveeeee margaritas and they had about 3/4 to choose from so I had 3 lol i don't remember all the names of three but I remember having a spicy jalapeño one and one with cinnamon. Both delicious and strong. Definitely stop by here if you're in town.
Ok guys this is one of my favorite vegan spots in Nashville everything is great would def recommend
We miss William!!! Reminiscing on our St Louis experience with his medicinal kombucha, amazing, creative meals. We wish we could come back and enjoy!!!

Sure, social distancing, masks are required, hand sanitizers, and instruction on how to wash your hands posted on the restroom walls...

BUT... we had several harrassing 'reminders' from the casino floor staff repeatedly admonishing customers to keep their masks on. Drinking? With a mask please. 
Smoking.  Must have mask on 'between puffs' we were told.

Not a fan of this very older crowd casino.  The bartender this morning at the bar by the front desk never washed his hands in the hour we sat at the counter. And the bloody mary he made us was so spicy it was undrinkable. 

Stayed at the adjacent motel which has a high Booking. Com rating but : unsavory clientele, no in-room Kleenex, no microwave.

Pluses: nice big TV,  golf channel, fridge and pleasant efficient front desk staff. Especially props to Amanda who allowed an early check-in. 

Housekeeping staff excellent, at least in this room. Trash removal and fresh towels. Bed made on our second day.  Soaps and shampoos provided both nights.

Its been ruled unconstitutional for the governor to tell you that you have to wear a mask.  It's only a suggestion. 

What happened in Vegas that made the Covid count so high was that the tests weren't processed for a few days, and then when they were, it appeared that a tremendous spike had occurred.  

Say goodbye to Reno and Vegas as both these gambling bergs are going downhill fast, as well as all Nevada with the shortfall in revenue this state is experiencing. 

Its the end of freed

Awesome Greek Salad was large and contained a nice mixture.  Staff was attentive and very quick to serve the lunch entree. My guest had the turkey sandwich which looked incredible.  Very pleased and will return to Triumph!  Kudos to restaurant for a great job!

Alright, so I've never had a Philly overnight until now, been looking forward to one, and this place totally topped all expectations! I didn't even mean to end up here. I was actually in the shuttle from the hotel to try a place the driver recommended the night before, and I was in full uniform when the driver randomly informed me that the place I was dying to try a cheesesteak from was actually a bar. Not a great look, a pilot walking into a bar in uniform. Fortunately, while we were discussing this issue I spotted a gem I'd heard about but couldn't find on google maps for whatever reason, and asked to stay there and give their Philly a try. 

HOLY CRAP!! This place is now one of my all
Time favorites from all my travels!! It was early, so the lady setting up outside wasn't quite ready, but when I preferred they went to work and got my Philly done FAST. That said, I'd wondered if I'd tipped enough (definitely not now that I've tasted the food), and thought it would be a bust. I walked back to my hotel, and tasted this cheesesteak, and it's like it got better with every single bite! It was quite literally one of the tastiest things I've ever had! Get the Big Philly with the hot peppers, large, and I promise you'll go back every time no matter where you are in philly. I can't wait to go back just to tip them more for their breathtaking food.

Very nice clean and attentive restaurant  The waiter actually announces the food and doesn't just walk away like other sushi places do. The music isn't too loud and it's just a civilized place to be. I'd highly recommend!
This is a great thin crust pizza with generous toppings!!  Minimal sauce.  We got 1/2 Godfather 1/2 Manhattan BBQ.  Both were so good!  I would recommend this place and come back when I'm in town!!

Excellent food and service! The garlic cheese bread is awesome! I love their pepperoni pizza. Nice selection of beer on tap. The service is top notch. We even got to try their mini cannolis on the house!

Seed was wonderful. We decided to do delivery (so full transparency, I don't know what it's like inside, what the sit down experience is, or anything about service). What I can say is that the food we ordered came very quickly and was delicious. 

In a city like NOLA with a rich culture of meat based food, it's always nice to find a plant-based gem. I REALLY loved the Bao, and would heartily recommend it to anyone. The only problem is portion size: if I'm being realistic, there should probably be 3 to a portion instead of 2 at its current price point. 

I was also a fan of the waffle fries and cheese sauce! The sauce was particularly good.

All in all, would eat again. Not everything on the menu is a winner (the cucumber salad was meh), but the actual entrees are truly delicious, even if slightly undersize in terms of portion. Looking forward to returning for a sit down experience some day.

I have gone to Bacio Italiano to pick up my take out cannoli 3 times now. I have tried cannolis from dozens of restaurants all over the world and this is by far my favorite!! 10/10!! I will continue to come to Bacio while I live in Arizona. - Cannoli addict
This was our first time their. We had a lite lunch. We had the pierogis an a flat bread. The service was great and the and ambience was fun. Will definitely be back.

Heard really amazing things about the mozzarella so had to try. Ordered the mozzarella cart and meatballs as  appetizers. The mozzarella was as I had heard; Very yummy and a neat experience to be able to see them create at your table. Only drawback was it was quite crowded and our table was very close to others so the moz. maker sort of wedged himself in but not enough and was very hard to hear. The meatballs were just OK. 

We moved on and ordered four different pasta dishes to share between four of us to share. I was not as impressed by the pasta to be honest. I thought two of the pasta dishes we got (spaghetti and tagliolini) just tasted like vermicelli from a box. I was pretty disappointed in by them and could not tell the difference in the shapes. We also tried the ravioli with short ribs which were OK but the short rib was a little dry and it was lacking enough sauce. The egg yolk ricotta tortello was probably the best of the four and was nice to try something different. We also shared the ribeye which is a shareable meat.  Admittedly ribeye is not my favorite (prefer filets) but it was lacking any real seasoning or sauce and the veggies that came with it were also just OK. We did not try the desserts. 

Overall it was pricey for what we got and I would've rather spent the money elsewhere. Adult beverages were very good though. I would rank Rocca behind Cena and Osteria for downtown Italian restaurants.

Oh I could go on and on about this trip, I am a single mom who took a huge risk to go visit my mom in Tennessee from Indiana and wanted to stay here at the Opryland resort close to my mom during this Covid time. Well even getting the reservation was not easy spelt my name wrong, email wrong and had to begged for confirmation numbers which I would normally not even ask for but couldn't believe how many times I had to give her my name and spell it out. Then I asked for two connecting rooms.. I had a friend going us and it is fun to have the kids in one side and parents in the other.. they failed to give me a connecting room after double checking at the time of reservation, then a call before check in and even at check in was told my two rooms were connected. Nothing worse then traveling carrying all your stuff and kids stuff as a single mom.. then get up to the two rooms and they are not connected. I called the front desk they told me there was not a single thing they would do.. beside give me a room with a king bed... unreal.. trash view, messed up rooms, no customer service!! Not to mention they are running on 1/2 full because of Covid.. so why do we get crappy rooms, and messed up reservations and.... no help to fix the issue. They treated me and my kids like Lower class citizens. Mind you my mom lives in Franklin and this is a beautiful places I was hoping to stay more often but I will never want to be treated so disrespectfully again. My kids are well behaved and there lac

The lines to get into this seafood treasure is always worth the wait!
Food is fresh from the ocean and top notch!
Love it 
Ricky A
Great service like ALL the other Cappriotti's. And this location does not get as busy at the other ones.

We walked in and were taken care of quickly. The pizza and wings were good. I loved them! My husband is a picky eater and so he wasn't too enthused about the extra garnish of garlic on the wings but it was easily removed. The food was reasonably priced and we enjoyed the atmosphere. I enjoyed seeing some of the unique ways they re-created their spaces for COVID. We had made reservations but arrived a little earlier and were seated promptly. However, as it got business, I noticed people getting grumpy about making reservations and having to wait. I think it was mainly due to not wanting to sit outside. They had heaters out there but we didn't sit out there so I'm not sure how well they worked. We would definitely visit this place again when we returned to Reno in the future.

Food wasn't bad but the service was horrible. We made reservations for 8:00pm and we were not sat until 8:35pm, with no explanation or apology. Then our server seemed annoyed when I asked for water stating "this is a 5 star restaurant, water comes with the meal". Not sure what he meant by that but I had an empty water glass for the majority of my dinner. We also had to ask if there were sides that came with the meal, we noticed other tables had mashed potatoes and we did not. It would have been nice if he would have offered them considering they were included. Seating is crammed and not very comfortable. My husband and I have loved every Brazilian Steakhouse we have been to but unfortunately will never return back to this one.

Really enjoyed Del Real for our first visit.  Very nice owner, Able, and super nice fella at bar,  John. Who actually bought us our round of drinks.  Question is... Why were those drinks on our bill too...hmmmmm.  Anyway I should have checked bill before we paid and left.  Probably an honest mistake on Abels part.  Will be back .  Dennis the menace.

Ordered food at 6:29 and food arrived at 9. The food is not edible and the smoothies are water. This is by far the worst experience and food that has come from Panera. We have enjoyed getting food from here often and this is enough for me to not visit again. Seriously disappointed.
Second time I've been here. Second time there's a dog up on the booth. Educate your staff. Service dogs stay on the floor!

Went here for a quick bite before we headed to the museum down the street. We sat outside and enjoyed people watching while we eat some super tasty feta fries, a pork pita and falafel pita with fresh veggies packed inside. Next time we'll come for breakfast-they have a little bakery with a nice selection of baked goods that looked amazing.

Note: The decor, like the service, is simple but nice. Not full service.
So good! Perfect little place to get breakfast. They have smoothies and juices! The strawberry banana crepes were delicious!!

I grew up in this area of Florida so I have been to hundreds of seafood/grill places that appear identical to Guppy's. 

Guppy's is different! Food is genuinely unique and very tasty. It's pretty expensive but it's worth it. The scallops with vanilla sauce were bomb and the lobster escargot is a must.

Years ago French family and friends recommended this spot for the brioche, back at their old location.
My favorite order is the sausage egg & cheese on a croissant and an almond croissant. Very buttery and greasy if that's your thing.
Recommend calling ahead to see if they're open because sometimes they are randomly closed.
The pineapple fried rice is absolutely amazing. I actually haven't strayed from this yet but I will soon. I've never had a bad meal here.

I went early in the morning on a weekday and even though it was packed, I was seated fairly quickly at the counter. Outside, they can take drink orders while you wait! Service was fantastic, the atmosphere was fun, and my food was delicious! Will definitely be back.

I always make a special effort to come here on every visit to Boise. The vibe is great, as is the food, beverages, and service. Had to go off of diet and ordered the flan for dessert... it was totally worth it. Keep up the good work!

I meet a friend i have not seen i n  a long time due to the pandemic after 2 hours and while we were still eating they asked us to leave because they had another reservation waiting.  It must be nice to ask people to leave your restaurant, while so many are struggling.

This is a quaint and confusing establishment (for first time visitors) due to the United usual way in which you place your order. With that said the food is excellent and seems to use the freshest ingredients   The OJ was outstanding and the breakfast burrito was upscale  (is there such a thing?) excellent coffee and shiek all ages hipster environment. I bought a lemon loaf which looked delish but I have baked better. Still I would go back but $50 for two for a semi self serve cafe is a bit much.

Visiting from Los Angeles and just arrived, we stopped here first for food.

The po boys here were EXCELLENT!!! And big portions as well. They didn't hold back!

5 stars! My wife had the fried shrimp po boy regular and I had the BBQ beef po boy. Both fully dressed. Definitely a must try if you want a good po boy.

Disappointed in the overpriced roast beef hoagie. First off I ask for the homemade roast beef that they have advertised on their menus board. The clerk was about to slice the Freda beef when I stopped him and asked about the homemade. He said that was for hot RB not cold. I didn't understand because it was in the case ready to slice. Finally they agreed to give me the homemade. I was shocked when I was told it was almost $16 for a regular hoagie and small bag chips. I got home and upon inspection for what a $14 hoagie looks like am sad to report not worth price. I asked for lettuce and got 1 wilted piece. I also asked for pickles and found a stringy mess what was once a pickle sliced thinner than the roast beef. Pickles should crunch when you bite into a sandwich   never see anything like it. I liked that they use Sarcone's bakery roll but the sandwich was more roll than anything. To make matters worse, the bag of chips expired on June 12 nearly 40 days ago. I can't believe the people of Newtown Square actually patronize this place. I guess they like throwing their money away. There are many more sandwich shops that make a better sandwich.

Vincenzo Trattoria was just ok; the dishes that we ordered just didn't say "wow" and they were still on the pricey side. I got the Spaghetti Alla Pescatore. It was just ok. Good sized shrimps, calamari wasn't chewy, and the clams were just ok. I wanted chili flakes and extra Parmesan cheese; I received the chili flakes but was told extra cheese didn't come with the Pescatore dish. What?!? I couldn't believe it. Plus the spaghetti was a little too al dente but I didn't want to fuss.  My wife got the Penne Alla Vodka. Sauce was very good but the penne pasta was even more under cooked. I would have sent her dish back but again; she didn't want to make a fuss so we just ate our dishes. Restaurant had little/no ambiance; just a strip mall unit with tables and chairs. Maybe we'll give it another chance since we live in Garden City; but for now our search for good Italian good continues...

Think you can't get great fish in a drive thru? Think again! This is my go to place. I adore the cod filet sandwich. They always make it fresh, to order, and never once, have they gotten my order wrong-it always comes without tartar sauce, just as I ask. I've ordered cheese curds several times-always a treat, and you get a generous amount. And their seasonal sides are great, too. (Please bring back the pretzel bites!) And then, there are the desserts. I want to try them all, but keep ordering the butterscotch concrete mixer. Trust me, you've gotta check out the offerings-the list is long and tempting! I mostly hit up the drive-thru but when I've been inside, it's always bright, clean and comfy. And the service, always friendly, warm and accommodating. Gotta love Culver's!

I was a loyal customer in the neighborhood. But the way they handle their business is extremely unfriendly. It's disturbing and unreasonable to enforce such a strict cancellation policy during the pandemic. My dinner date was feeling sick. I called the restaurant and explained the difficult situation and that I didn't want to put the restaurant server and other customers at risk. And that I could reschedule the dinner. But they refused to give me that option and insisted on charging me a $100 cancellation fee. 

Super disappointed and I don't recommend anyone going there if you want to be treated with decency.
I prefer going to this Olive Garden. I love the environment and the service is usually great not to mention good pasta and other choices.

We "USED" to be regulars since we lived in Monrovia 7 miles from our door,Not anymore!,Our last visit
 (3 yrs) that all changed. Barely warm anything,Mashed potatoes HORRIBLE
No doubt instant,All food went downhill!,I Know Larry Gray would be spinning in his grave,That was our LAST VISIT!.

We went here based on the yelp reviews and a blurb about this place from the Food Network. The Mac and cheese, chicken wings and beer selection were all great and we appreciated they were open and operating safely during COVID. The beef brisket was "meh" - it's very greasy. I'm sure there is amazing BBQ in Nashville, we just didn't find it here.

This is by far one of the worst restaurants I've been to both for food and service. With three kids, and on a tight timeline, we would have had a much better experience driving out of our way to go to a McDonalds. Let's start off by saying when we arrived, we hadn't placed our orders for a good 15-20 minutes, which by that point, when one of us ordered a hamburger, our waitress then says that they're out of hamburgers.  This on a Sunday morning for brunch.  Should have known it was going to get worse.  This is after we had already sat down and the waitress "went over" the menu . I put that in quotes because she barely did that.  Then, about 20 minutes later after we ordered what they did have on the menu, and buttered noodles for the kids, they tell us they are out of PASTA!  This is significantly after we told them we need things moving quickly to get the kids home for naps.  The waitress looks at us and says, "Well, I'm just the messenger."   At that point, we've been sitting there for about 35 minutes with kids that need to eat and take naps.  To make matters worse, I had ordered my one egg omelette not over-cooked.  So, yet again, the "messenger" must have not told the kitchen staff how to cook they egg, because then they came out asking if I wanted the egg cooked over easy or over medium....it's an egg people!  I worked as a waitress for ten years in restaurants.  When you get an order, you put it in the computer and it goes back to the kitchen.  The kitchen staff at tha
I absolutely love their Tom yum soup with chicken. It's always fresh and delicious. I can have it everyday

If you are passing through Reno for breakfast the locals have a real winner for breakfast. Pine State Biscuits has several places in Portland OR, where I tried there breakfast . 
This time I saw Blueberry Cornmeal Pancakes on the menu .I had to try them. I know  Pine State has made from scratch biscuits which are a must to have.
We ordered 2 stacks of the Blueberry Cornmeal Pancakes plus and order of over easy eggs and of course a made from scratch biscuit. 
They have an Apple Butter which I highly recommend to spread on your pancakes, biscuits ,etc. . Made the meal twice as enjoyable.
This place is a HOME RUN!!!!!

First time trying Ethiopian food! There was definitely a learning curve to feel comfortable eating without utensils. I thought the food was pretty good, different. Reminded me of a mix of African soul food and Indian food. It's worth a try!

Been coming here for a few years now, always just as good as the last. Service is always somehow more pleasant and consistent than most places in the city. I've been twice during covid and even with the outdoor seating service has been quick, friendly and helpful. Dogs are always good, i've found my favorite to be the Kansas City Beefs. Good beer choices, always a solid place to come to.

Best ever tacos and tamales! I've lived in Central America and have found the usual  Mexican restaurants sadly lacking,till I discovered Los Primos! Not to mention their great baked goods and desserts!

Supporting our local businesses plus after picking up my Hubs from a medical outpatient center..he asked for Brusco's Calzones. How could I resist?! Also we enjoy their pizza and wings. Encourage you to check them out too!
They also offer curbside pickup.

It made me so happy when I realized a new Dim Sum spot in NOLA was opening. Don't get me wrong. I LOVE Maypop (only available on weekends), Wishing Town Bakery (all the way out in Kenner) and Panda King (again, only available on weekends) but as you can see they all have their cavoites.

And along comes Dian Xin. Not going to lie, the excessive wait at first was a deterrent but as soon as I figured out their waitlist (available through Yelp) that you can use without having to actually go to the restaurant to have to put your name on the list I was elated. It made the whole waiting experience so much better. The venue is small, not in a bad way, just not great for a huge waiting line.

Now on to the food. Perfection. All the dumplings, steamed and fried, chicken, pork, beef and vegetables. My friend and easily enjoyed 10 item menu and had to bring a lot of it home. Reasonably priced. Super delicious. I can't wait to go back.
This restaurant has exceptional food!  Service is slow, but great ambiance.  Don't miss it when going to Nashville!

I adore this place! Considering that it is not on the actual beach, it's pretty cool. It is surrounded by mangroves, so you see plenty of Manatee. The drinks are very tropical and a fun place to take those wanting a tiki beachy experience. It looks like they might be expanding as well-and I just learned that you could rent paddle boards from there! Can't wait to see the growth of this location. The music is great in the vibe is awesome! I love coming here :)

I've been here a few times now and have tried a number of different menu items. I've never been disappointed! The made to order items are just as delicious as the pastries. I highly recommend trying the croque-madame (a French dish, it's a grilled ham and cheese sandwich with a fried egg on top). They make it on their homemade bread, which is nice and thick.

Got spring rolls, pork belly buns and two pho with beef. Springs rolls were ok, not worth it, not even the peanut sauce helped. Pho was horrible, the worst pho I've ever had in my life. The meat was very soggy and didn't cook in the broth because the bowl was not hot enough. Also the pho comes with the mint, bell sprouts and jalapeños already in the pho. Most places bring it on a side plate so I was confused when I saw it already in my plate. In all fairness it does say it as part of the ingredients on the menu, but I thought it came on the side. The broth had no flavor, even with sauces and all those other ingredients added. This place was very disappointing. It was the perfect rainy cold day for pho and I wasted it at this spot. 

The only reason they're getting two stars is because the Pork belly buns were really good. The sauce on the pork belly had a lot of flavor. If you're looking for anything other than pork belly's, I would stay far away from here.

I love Gils! It's authentic Mexican. The street corn is amazing. The tacos are superb. The red and green hot sauce that you can get on the side to add to the tacos are so good. The red is super spicy and I love spicy food. Definitely give this place a try for some authentic Mexican food!
The food was good here. The service was ok, but not great. We just came in for sandwiches/po-boys.

God bless THE ardmore station cafe. It is my absolute favorite for a variety of reasons: it has some character, is drastically different from its uppity mainline breakfast joint counterparts, it's affordable, and the food is to die for. They were open and accommodating on New Year's Day, and we called in some black bean breakfast burritos. Perfect for a non-meat eater like myself. I've enjoyed everything I've tried here in the past: the stuffed french toast is another definite highlight. The strawberry and Nutella variety is a classic -- you've just got to come hungry. Did I mention the prices?? $4.50 for an egg and cheese bagel WITH breakfast potatoes. Minellas is shaking in their boots. I'm one of your biggest fans, ardmore station cafe! I reserve 5 star ratings for only the best of the best!
Seafood pasta was amazing.   Crab cakes could us a little old bay seasoning.  Great service.
Very good food, excellent service. This place was insanely busy from the moment we arrived to the moment we left! But, they were cranking the food out. Everything was so yummy!!!

This used to be my favorite sushi place in Reno, but a while ago they closed to renovate and since they reopened the quality has dropped almost entirely while the prices have been raised significantly. I just ordered their 20 piece sashimi and the quality varied wildly between the 4 different fish in the combo and one of them even still had the fin attached on a couple of the pieces of sashimi. First plate of sushi or sashimi me and my girlfriend didn't finish in 5 years.

Having ethnic roots in Poland, I was delighted to hear this bakery made Easter lamb cakes. I called them and was told I had to prepay ($35+tax). When I picked the cake up, not only was I shocked at the tiny size of the cake, but I was appalled over the "plastic" lamb face and skimpy frosting job. You can see through the frosting and some other glaze is on the face. See photo! This is coming from a Master Baker & Master Pastry Chef!! Then the lamb was not secured in the box and toppled over after getting it home. Box is huge compared to lamb.

I have not tasted it yet but 2 stars for outrageous cost and VERY POOR WORKMANSHIP!  The cheap frosting job and skimpy glaze (?) on lamb face is unacceptable!!

I have a cast iron lamb mold and should have tried to find it in my moving boxes and made my own!!

I like big dogs and I cannot lie. You other brothers can't deny. When a killer Chicago Dog gets in your face, you'll go boom.

The celery salt, two sabrent dogs in a big bun, and that neon green relish. You have found it.

The dinosaur sized pretzel is a wonder of physics, add it to your list. Buttery, salty carb overload!

The canoli. BEST in RENO. I swear in my mind this is true. I hope you'll agree. I have studied the rest. I have spoken.

The Tiramisu is also another culinary marvel. Whom ever makes this is a master. I have had many good ones since 2006 all around this county. This is my happy place.

Your looking out the window enjoying a nice view of Mount Rose, what else can you ask for?

My family used to go here a lot but it's been awhile so my fiancé and I decided to order delivery from here. We ordered a chicken cheese steak, mild & sriracha agave wings, and a brad Fox burger. The burger was decent. The chicken cheese steak was okay as well. Both of those meals were supposed to come with fries but we got 1 teeny tiny order of fries that we barely could share. It was sad. The wings though break my heart! They used to be so amazing but these were so bland! I don't know how wings could have such little flavor and be so rubbery. I'm super disappointed because they used to churn out such quality food. I guess I'll have to find another wing place to go to since the quality has severely dropped here.
My husband, daughter and I stopped by for breakfast and enjoyed the food and service! Oscar is a great waiter and took very good care of us

It was closed when I got there to pick up my take-out meal!! I find this outrageous. Luckily I was able to get my money back from GrubHub.  I do appreciate the apology and explanation I received from AViANNA.
Very authentic cuisine. Everything here is delicious. I Highly recommend coming. It's a very busy place. Service is pretty decent too.
Review is based on service and atmosphere. We didn't order food. It is a very nice rooftop in downtown Indy.. waiters are very friendly.

Horrible food tasted like cafeteria food. Perhaps go there for a drink after you've finished your shopping because they do have a nice roof deck. The fries were OK, however McDonald fries are better. So yes order fries (if you're hungry) with a drink but that's about it. My server was also weird. Not really nice at all. I tipped 30% cash and he didn't even acknowledge or say thank you! He just ran away with the money. I won't be back!

When I moved to the Midwest, I discovered Kaldis coffeehouse. It was friendly enough and the food menu was great. Over the next few years, the menu devolved from Match Burgers and delicious breakfast to premade yuckiness. 

They took frapuccinos off the menu, and when I asked for something similar, the staff reminded me "that's bad for you!" No duh it's bad for me. I want a treat. And I'm not going to buy treats from you anymore.

Arni's treats their customers right!! We ordered takeout (during the pandemic) like most have and it was DELICIOUS and fresh. However, upon opening our food at home we realized that 2 of your orders of boneless wings had the wrong sauce on them. When I called to let them know, they were not only apologetic and extremely polite but also offered a credit for future orders. Thanks Arni's for taking care of your customers! Makes us want to come back over and over again!!

What a joke!!!! I was incredibly disappointed in this place because when we arrived there was a long line outside the diner. When my salad arrived, I knew I was in trouble. When my entrée arrived, honey fried chicken, I was mortified and DONE. What a ridiculous diner.

So let me say this...this restaurant has the best service ever!!! I would come back based on the service alone. Also their coctails are to die for! I was hestitant ask but my friend asked our waiter if they could make me a "hurricane". Omg that was one of the best drinks I ever had. My drink was mixed to perfection!

Now moving onto the food. I ordered the gumbo for my appetizer. It was delicious! The texture was perfect and so was the presentation. My friends' salads also looked great.

Now moving onto the steaks. I ordered the 8 oz fillet mignon (well done). My other friends ordered the 20 oz prime bone-in rib- eye (medium well). Well lets just say my fillet mignon was definately "rare" and very red in the middle and overly charred on the outside. I told the waiter and they just took it back and cooked it longer. Overall, I didnt like my steak and have had better steaks at cheaper places. This is dissappointing for a restaurant with such an extensive steak menu.

Now my other friends who ordered the 20 oz prime rib ordered their steaks medium well and they were only slightly pink (barely could tell), so they appeared to be more done than my so-called well done steak.

I also ordered the collard greens as a side and they were too greasy for my taste. There is an art to cooking collard greens. It is indeed necessary to add a fat based product in order soften up the collards and make them edible and able to retain flavor, but you must accurately measure the correct amount of f
My search for the best pad Thai in south tampa is finally over!! I've tried a ton and hands down Thai 5 is the best!

I. Love. This. Place.

Whenever I have friends visiting from out of town, this is where I take them! My favorite items here are the stuffed French toast and the Mexi scramble. Pesto in eggs? Who would have known? 

The Mexi scramble seems basic, but is SO flavorful and delicious -- I crave it constantly and have never had anything like it anywhere else. At a certain point, there's only so much you can do with eggs, until Sabrina's proves you wrong!

Get the stuffed French toast -- thank me later. If you're more of a savory breakfast person but want to try it, pro tip: THEY OFFER HALF ORDERS! Seriously some of the BEST French toast I have ever eaten in my life. Whatever fluffy cream they stuff that toast with is stuff straight from heaven. No exaggeration. Pure bliss.

Bonus: they have sriracha AND Cholula here, which is basically the best thing ever.

I recommend getting on their waitlist if you're coming on a busy weekend during peak hours -- this is an easy and convenient system and the staff is always super helpful and it goes smoothly. Restrooms are clean, and the restaurant is beautiful. 

Before coming to Sabrina's, I really thought brunch was so normalized and I had seen it all in all it's variations -- thank you for proving me wrong and getting me excited to get up early enough to share a meal here!

Quick cheap authentic Mexican food!  Many great places in Norristown but everyone here speaks English and I have had no language barriers when ordering or asking questions.  I've been to at least three places in Norristown where it has been a slight problem.
Not that it's bad it just what happened.  2.75 for a taco authentic.25 more for supreme great deal.  Alambre is a huge plate of meat and veggies best deal on the menu for 10$.  I ordered chips and salsa for 4$ and it has been a huge thing of pick de

I cannot even count how many times we have eaten here. Big Fish Grill is one of, if not my favorite restaurant! The food is always fresh and flavorful, and the staff are always kind and attentive. For the longest time I was stuck on ordering the Big Shrimp Penne. I would get it every time we came and was always satisfied. However, I have started to get more adventurous and am now trying almost everything on the menu, and am getting something new every time I come. I have the confidence that everything I try will be delicious, and so far I have been right! Along with the main courses, the appetizers are also great! We usually get the shrimp cocktail, and the shrimp are always super meaty. It is also impossible to dine here without getting dessert. We always go for the peanut butter pie. It is very big, creamy, and overall wonderful. The atmosphere is another plus, both inside and out. The big sea creatures hanging from the ceiling are always fun to look at, and the river behind the restaurant is also some nice scenery if you are dining outside. If it is a warmer day, I also recommend taking a walk along the river after dinner! Overall, Big Fish Grill is an amazing restaurant in all aspects of dining and I highly recommend it to anyone and everyone!

If I could give this place zero stars I would. I've been here for breakfast, in the afternoon, and late at night. No matter what time I go it is ridiculously slow and takes forever to get my food at the drive-through. As I am writing this right now I'm in the drive-through which I've been sitting behind three other cars for the last 20 minutes at least. This will be the last time I come here.

Select is a great addition to the Warrington area. From the salads to the pastas, everything is delicious! As a picky eater, I have been able to find many dishes I love here! Our server Deanna has been phenomenal on multiple occasions. Always patient when the table is trying to decide, attentive, and informative of what the "favorites" on the menu are. We dined in tonight and were disappointed when she wasn't serving! The A+ service definitely makes the restaurant out of this world!

In town for an overnight stay and wanted something within walking  distance from our hotel.

Awful, slow service at 5:25 pm and the restaurant is not even at capacity due to COVID 19.

Will never return

Really great pho and bahn mi sandwiches. Also they have a good ramen and I love the egg rolls. My wife gets the vegetarian pho and she loves it. They often have young coconuts from Thailand that are absolutely delicious and refreshing. Service is attentive and friendly. They always remember us so that's really nice. They also have a very cosy outdoor patio with good shade and wind cover. Highly recommended. It's our go to for our Reno Asian food fix. Tonight we tried their creme brûlée. Pretty good!

Love the place, good food , deserts , only issue I have is despite having amazing espresso beans, the espresso and drinks are not dialed in correctly. Most of time my cappuccino, taste burned. And I don't like the fact they ask you one shot of 2. You cannot make a proper cap with one shot. Just put 18g in a basket.

The bbq shrimp starter was the best thing on the menu. We tried the crawfish etouffee and it was watery...for $16?!?! Then we had the self-proclaimed heavenly crab cakes which were dry. I've definitely had better. For my entree, I had the Death by Gumbo and if I should die of a broken heart over an andouille sausage overpowered flavored and watery gumbo with overdone duck, then yeah, I could've died trying to eat it. Very disappointing for the menu prices. Not returning ever.

It is rare that I write a review, but warranted for this case. Everything we ordered at 1st Indian Kitchen was absolutely delicious, portions were large, and restaurant was well-run. This will definitely be our go-to place for Indian food going forward!

I am a pretty big fan of Korean food.  During Covid, we've been following all of the guidelines and have not been eating out very much at all.  It's only in the last few weeks that we've been adding 1-2 meals a week from "out" to our lockdown routine.

The choice for the weekend was Korean and Tony's was a new place to try.  They are basically at 141 & Olive and located inside an Asian market (look for the signs).

Between chatting with friends in the parking lot and driving home, the food was probably 45-minutes removed from cooking by the time we ate it and I don't think it suffered hardly at all.  Here's what we had and some thoughts:

General note: healthy portions for the price and everything tasted/looked/felt very fresh.

Kimchi fried rice - my first time trying the dish and I was not a fan.  Sadly, as I only have one data point, I cannot comment on how good their version is compared to others.

Mandu - those things probably were capable of melting most of the layers of skin off the roof of my mouth when we picked them up but after a 45-minute wait they were still warm and crispy enough to come across as a great choice.  In general, deep-fried foods don't seem to travel or reheat well but that wasn't an issue as the whole order was consumed at the first sitting.

Pan-fried duk bok gi - absolutely delicious!  I've only ever had this dish in the spicy red sauce so this was a new flavor profile.  Somehow there was still a little heat (a good thing!) in the dish even witho

Four of my girlfriends and I were in the area and decided to try out Hopdoddy because we wanted to go to a new local place. Immediately as we walked in we got snappy attitudes. We sat down to look at the menu, instead of standing at the door or blocking the line. We get barked at that we don't get served at our tables. That was not the only worker that gave us an issue. The food was great and came out in a good time, however the condescending attitudes that came from every worker we spoke to almost drove us away before even ordering. 
If you do get past the rude employees try the truffle fries and/or the sweet potato fries, we had both and finished every bite!

Great broth for the beef pho, but not enough briscuit in the mix with eye of the round.

Mom got the pan fried noodles and loved the shrimp and calamari; gave me the beef. Said noodles were too salty, too.

We will be back, and ask for extra calamari and briscuit!

No atmosphere; strip mall location, and limited parking because of gym and Starbucks. Does carry-out a lot.
Great prices.

The pizza and meatball sandwiches are great, however, they "forgot" to bring out my order after telling me to wait in my car. I called at 4:00 pm for the pizza & added soup to the order and was asked to wait outside as they would bring out the order. At 4:45 I went back in to see what the holdup was. I If you actually want your food - WAIT INSIDE!

It's very expensive especially if you want to add anything to an order even extra sauce is $1 meals are already $10 and that doesn't include a beverage. The food is ok but all of the fake meat is soy based which I try to stay away from so I wish they had a bean protein option. I wish they had more warm options if you get a rice bowl the only thing warm is the rice and protein. Flavor is pretty bland no real seasoning but at least a "clean food" offering so I appreciate that.

The food here was ok. I didn't really enjoy the bbq shrimp and grits , it was a bit tangy to me . However the biscuit was my favorite part..nice and soft ! The morning margaritas was also very delicious .
Suggested Badfins to friends that were on the beach. Everyone loved what they ordered and I was a hero for the suggestion!
No inside dining currently. But the food is delicious! I got the Superdome and the Bourbon Street Love. Everything is seasoned so well

This is fantastic pizza some of the best take out I've had. We ordered 4 pies each of different kinds all were excellent! The full clove if garlic on the tomato pie was a bit much but the sauce was exceptional! Next time I'm in philly this is a go to especially in Fishtown.

Visited Morrows today and the food was pretty good. I got the charbroiled oysters which were DELICIOUS and the redfish Acadia ?? It was good but VERY salty. 
The Mac and cheese was on the mediocre side. The food was good but it is a bit OVER RATED!

I like the decor, modern look, cozy and clean and our server and the people there are friendly and the service was fantastic and the food was delicious except the Brussels sprouts wasn't crispy it's was soft but still delicious though... definitely coming back.

Really good breakfast place. Our waitress was very attentive and kind. The food did not disappoint! Mimosa pitcher was a highlight for sure. They do recognize all COVID related safety precautions which was comforting. The restaurant itself was quaint and had these metal plate art on the wall. If you need a place to eat breakfast that you can count on this is definitely the place you want! Professional but also very cute restaurant. Loved it (:

Maialina is an amazing addition to the Fountain Square restaurant scene--excellent food in a beautifully decorated space! From classic Italian favorites to new and interesting combinations, the menu offers a wide range of tastes and flavors. Do yourself a favor and order the garlic parmesan toast and the prosciutto wrapped melon to start. And be sure to save room for affogato for dessert. Looking forward to making many more visits here in the future!
This is my favorite place! The margaritas are excellent and the specials are worth trying! The food is very fresh and tasty.

This place caught me off guard - in a very positive way. The only negative is I often eat too much and need a nap. Everything I have tried is good. Currently into the brisket and teriyaki chicken. The Spam fried rice is pretty tasty. Huge portions, proceed with caution!

My wife and I were craving some Mexican food, and she loves street tacos. She ordered the 3 steak street tacos tacos meal that should have came with beans and rice. Instead, she got 3 flour tortillas with steak. No cilantro, onions, tomatillo sauce, rice or beans. We won't be back.

Their tortas are amazing. From big features like the bread down to the bits of lettuce LOL. Quality ingredients make a quality torta. The chicken and asada ones are my favorite, not to mention how friendly their employees are every time! Gracias por servir Reno y asegurarse que este satisfecha :)

Loved getting a taste of Austin BBQ in the Midwest. One of the owners hails from the famous Franklin BBQ. Got some sandwiches (well-priced at about $11) that were very tasty for lunch while we grabbed a beer on the patio of Metazoa (Old Gold is a good truck on the brewery's patio). Got the potato salad and mac and cheese as our sides. Mac and cheese was the clear winner between the two. So good with a slight green chile flavor.

First, the service is impeccable. Every time! The breakfast items are great and today for the first time o ordered a salad. The Kale super food and it was delicious! They work with local vendors which is important to me as well! Highly recommended!
Absolutely wonderful food! Great gyros, and hummus! We love this place. They are so friendly and kind. They always remember our order, my name, and my allergies.

I am irritated that I did not try here earlier.  In a area with a pizza place everywhere you look it is hard to stand out.

I have been here now 5 times and no longer frequent any of the other places.  So what makes this place stand out you ask?  Good question.... I dont know how but his dough is actually tasty.  Most places the dough is like wonder bread soft and no flavor.  Next is the sauce.  It is bright but not too sweet or too thick.  My favorite is his grandmother's pizza.  Square pie like a sicilian but the dough is not allowed to rise. It is crispy and delicious and I reccomend the one with prosciutto.

The veggie is also good because the veggies are not mush they are properly cooked and still taste like what they are supposed to.

I highly recommend this local shop as it is a few steps above the other area places.

I was visiting Philly for a day and I have to say, this cute little place was my best experience here. If you've got the time and like drinks, stop by here! I got their hojicha latte and it blew away my expectations! And they have so many great culinary books! Definitely a perfect place to get some work done in quiet. They have a tank of cute fish and plants everywhere. I will definitely come back next time I'm on the east coast.

I have absolutely no complaints about this place at all. The staff is great. The food is great. Their customer service is amazing and there's a rewards program!!!! This place replaced Puccinos as my long time breakfast spot! Don't hesitate to try it.

Finally got to try the famous loveless fried chicken! Man, it did not disappoint! The chicken had the perfect balance of batter to chicken ratio. Loved the breading and the chicken was moist, not dry. I got the sides hash brown casserole and southern creamed corn. I really liked both by I prefer the corn. We called ahead and ordered our food to go. You park on the pickup spot and they will deliver your food. We decided to take one of the empty tables and enjoy our meal. Since it's Covid loveless transformed their parking lot and added pick-nick tables and chairs all around (more than 6ft apart). When we saw a couple left one of the workers outside quickly cleaned and wiped down the tables. Next time I have family visiting I will definitely come back and take them here. I love some good southern food!

Great food and even better customer service.  A coworker and myself on business in Edmonton for the week decided to leave the hotel area and head downtown for a good meal.  On the recommendation of trip advisor we were directed to Meat, a bbq smokehouse in the downtown core.  I had been once before on another business trip about 2 years ago and the experience was decent overall.  This subsequent visit was outstanding.  In addition to the well prepared food, our server Melissa Doro was exceptional.  A very welcoming and vibrant personality, great direction and recommendations on the menu and consistent check-ins to ensure we had what we needed and that the food was as good as it should be.  The brisket was moist and well smoked.  The cauliflower was simply delicious.  The fried chicken was crisp and tasty.  The ribs however were not on par with the rest of the meal.  Melissa however had taken note and ensured we received a fresh, not overcooked and delicious replacement which was unexpected but very much appreciated.  The finger bowls to clean up following the meal was also a nice and welcoming touch.  Melissa felt she had done nothing special and just did what she believed her job entailed.  That may be the case but her level of attentiveness and overall customer service is a rare experience these days and made this visit worth the trip downtown.  Needless to stay, the next trip to Edmonton will include a visit to Meat for some delicious eats and my new favourite server.  Tha
Plenty of boat docking and the food was excellent. Burger cooked to perfection and hot fries. Other members of a party had the fish and chips and they enjoyed. Shout out to our great waitress, Kelly.

Where to start...

Me and my friend ordered lemon pepper wings, mild wings, smothered turkey chops with sides: mac n cheese, cabbage & collard greens, green beans, mashed potatoes with gravy, and sweet potatoes. This came with cornbread and we also got a banana crumble, a lemon cake and two sweet teas. NOT A SINGLE THING WAS DISAPPOINTING. I don't know what those beans were flavored with but damn were they delicious. I have never cleared a plate so fast in my life. 

We ordered via DoorDash and even with delivery pickup we still got everything pretty quickly and it was all cooked to perfection. 

I honestly want to call the restaurant tell them how good this was but I don't want it to be weird
Really the only way to describe the food was dry all across the board. Can't understand how the food could be so dry and I would've complained but had I would have to have a serve around to do so.
Amazing burger and fries. Had the black and bleu. Sooooo worth coming here!! Husband had a bacon burger and he's picky about having a good burger. He loved it!!
Juice is amazing. Did kale, orange & banana. All fresh squeezed. Had a fresh wheatgrass shot they served with orange wedges. Had to stop and rate them as they were awesome. So nice.

I just love this place!  The Senior Special is amazing.  I get the beef brisket meal which comes with a very generous portion of meat plus two sides and a yummy muffin with homemade apple butter.  They have sweet and hot sauce or a combo with a little of both.  All of this for seniors 55 and older for just $10. (Drink, tax, and tip not included)

The last two visits I had Franklin as my server.  I found out this time that he is a veteran who served our country for five years in the armed forces.  THANKS AGAIN, FRANKLIN, for your sacrifice for all of us who stayed home!
You can tell the military influence in Franklin as he is such a great server.  I eat out a lot being alone and not liking to cook for one.  Franklin is genuine.  He has a great smile and is so intent upon making his guests happy and fed.  He does an awesome job with both.
I asked to see the manager to let her know how much I appreciated my server and no surprise to me, she said she gets many compliments about this fine young man. 
The food is always served quickly.  The food arrives hot to very warm and is always delicious.  I could take some home if I didn't enjoy it so much that I finish everything at the restaurant.
When looking for good barbeque you can't go wrong with Squealer's on the North West side of Indy.

Great place, lots of beers to taste - but this whole mask and glove thing isn't going as plan for them I think. Saw a sever carrying a iPad touching his ears with gloves on. Talk about gross. Even know my girlfriends burger was over cooked to well. And she ordered a medium.

Supreme pizza
Consistency is vital for a restaurant to flourish and keep a loyal customer base, especially in uncertain times. 
 I ordered a supreme pizza today based on pictures and reviews hoping to be wowed! Needless to say when I opened the box to verify my order, I was completely shocked. The small amount of vegetable toppings was ridiculous. I almost felt like they were running out. Zero presentation. 
The prices seem high for the output you receive. The $10 Greek salad was certainly not worth it for the same reasons I mentioned earlier. They take portion control to a whole new level.
I'd love to give it a 3.5, but I'm giving them the benefit of the doubt. The tacos are solid. However the chicken tacos were very dry and flavorless. The steak, pork, and alpastor I would do again.

You need to bring a lot of time coming here. 25 Minutes just to buy some bagels, no thank you. Come after 9:30 and they are usually out, not making fresh ones. Seems they have a lot of turn over and not keeping up with properly training new staff. Slow, s o  s l o w !
Trinity needs a decent Bagel shop!

Friendly staff, quality ingredients, great ambiance and the pizza is delicious! I will definitely be back! They have options for every palate. We are so excited that blaze became part of our community

HOT DIGGGITYYY DOGGGG this place rules. The lady and I split a cheese pup,cheeseburger and some cheese fries (fully loaded with some real wiz,none of that fugazi pizza store slop). I gotta tell ya gang, the service was just as good as the grub. Friendly,attentive counter girls and the grill jockey who I believe is the owner is a real hoot. I think we spent a whopping $20 after tip for the food and a couple bottomless colas. Everything fresh and made to order and juicy as all heck. Give it a shot gang, I know I'll be back!

I eat here often. A good last minute place to pop into for a good meal. I normally order the sushi which is tasty. I ordered the Pho and felt like it was on the smaller side. I normally get a larger order everywhere else. Also disappointed that they don't have a good sushi roll lunch combo like other places. I would still return because the food is good
Great food, big fat mussels and shrimp. Would come again. Service was a little slow but they were pretty packed so it was understandable. Waitress was nice!

Meh. Only one girl making the salads so the wait was annoying, but I love city greens so worth the wait right? Wrong. I ordered the chicken teriyaki bowl, get all the way to the end of the line, and the worker put the wrong sauce on the entree. Only for another worker to finally come out the back and tell her that they're out of teriyaki sauce to make the bowl as listed. So not only did she put the wrong sauce on, they didn't even have the teriyaki in the first place. THIS IS THE ITEM I CAME FOR. I settled for a hastily prepared Thai wrap as a salad. It was as meh as my experience. Advice? Have more than one worker on the line during dinner time (7pm) and know what ingredients you have available before wasting food making entrees that you can't complete. I'll stick to the Metairie and Elmwood locations.

My friends and I came here on a Friday night for a triple date. Unfortunately they won't seat you until the entire party is there.. and I was late so we missed out on an open table. :/

They had us wait about 30 minutes.. we ended up going back to my friends house to wait since it was raining.. but you can definitely wait inside the little doorway if you're in a small group.

Love that it's BYOB. The price of our entire meal of 3 pies was so reasonable. The cheese pie was my favorite by far. We also got a pepperoni and a white with panchetta and potatoes.. very good but very rich. My boyfriend was obsessed with the hot sauce here.. they make it in house. He's convinced they could bottle it and be millionaires.

Only con was there is 1 woman as the waitress and food runner for everyone.. so we had to wait a little bit for our wine to be opened and to get some waters.

I will 100% be back.. it was so good.

Long time reader, first time Yelper.  First, I want to note that we are local in the Philly area despite the "San Fran" tag on my name which I must figure out how to change!  

I am generally a big fan of PJ Clark's having been to the original in NYC several  times since the turn of the year.  My wife and I recently had a great Sunday lunch at the Philadelphia location @ 4th & Walnut and thought "WOW - so happy this place is here!".  We really talked it up and ended up taking our 2 girls there to celebrate our oldest's 18th birthday this past Saturday night.  Regrettably, the meal nor the experience lived up to our hype or expectation.  

The service although pleasant was extremely slow despite the restaurant side of the house not being terribly busy. I also had to send back a Tito's and soda because the soda was "flat".  The second try was marginally better though I think they might want to rethink the individual bottles of soda bottles and opts for fountain gun instead.  It seemed to take ages to get drinks, ages to get starters and mains.  Also, despite alerting the establishment that we were celebrating an 18th birthday, no acknowledgement was forthcoming which was a bit of a shame.   

The food was also a real disappointment I am afraid.  The french fries - generally a mortal lock for being outstanding - were at best luke warm upon arrival after clearly sitting on the serving station for too long.  My wife and oldest daughter ordered the skirt steak frite which was so to
Great place for sushi! Service and atmosphere is always fantastic! Selection and freshness and quality outstanding!!

This place is always my got-to. I love this place with all my heart. My friends and I come here every Friday to let off stress and get out Italian on!
I could not imagine a world without this place! This week I am so sad to say I cannot go to my fav Italian place. I love you and I will miss you when I move.

When the menu says "only the freshest ingredients" they mean ONLY THE FRESHEST INGREDIENTS!! The chicken mozzarella sandwich was deliciously perfect lol. My colleague and I both had it and could not stop raving. He also had the vegetable soup and would've licked the bowl if he could. The baklava and chocolate chip cookie were the perfect treat after we were all done. Funny enough, we were actually heading to another spot on the block and saw a crowd of people walking in so we decided , "hey this must be the spot!!!" Very VERY HAPPY we stopped in.

Stopped in on Saturday afternoon.  Nice people,  very friendly,  fun bartender,  young woman who wasn't usually there during day. Food was good,  predictable,  Pittsburg filet dine right.  Definitely go back.

The best meatballs and strombolis in philly!! And of course the best variety of pasta ever!! The delivery drivers are fast and nice!! They also have some of the best desserts I have ever tasted!! Plz go and order from here you wont be disappointed!!

This place is amazing, the scenery to start off with is so relaxing you can literally spend there all day and find something to do for each hour. The temple itself is gorgeous with its deep colors and architecture. The food? The food is bomb. I had the soup (vegetarian) and it was rich I loved it and I normally don't like noodle soups like this because they're always salty but this one was great. I also had the wings ERMMAAAGERSHHHHH I will definitely be getting those every time I go to the temple. This place will definitely one of my go to's for a calm and relaxing Sunday morning with good food and nice people.
Long wait in line to find out that they are out of an item that I was just told was available. Don't go past 6 on the weekend. They will be out of most things

My new favourite Mexican food restaurant which serves up fresh authentic food. Not too greasy like a lot of fake Mexican places serve up. Staff was super friendly and the chef had even said hi to us that evening.
The food here is delicious and dependable. The person who takes your order is happy to explain your options and answer all your questions. I will definitely be back.

Unfortunately, this location isn't nearly as good as the broad ripple location. Food was very bland. Servers and the manager seemed to be rushing my boyfriend and I to get out which made us feel very uncomfortable. Reason being, beaches there was 5 other families and parties that came after us.... Not a diverse crowd so the treatment was different from Broad Ripple location. Again, it wasn't just how we were treated the food was also not as good as the Broad Ripple location.

My friend and I went to Molly Malloy's for lunch where the food was great and the waitress was friendly. There was one server who wasn't very friendly on a couple occasions throughout the meal. On the way out my friend and I told the manager we had a great experience with the exception of how she treated us and we would be back later with a larger group.

We came back a few hours later in a group of 4 and when we did the manager treated us all to a drink. When the bill came they comped all the alcohol. This is a great place to go.

Came here for a Sunday funday brunch! I like how you can make reservations on Opentable so we were seated upon arrival. Service was a bit slow but it was a full restaurant on a Sunday at noon. Unfortunately, they do not have bottomless drinks for brunch but the next best thing is their $25 champagne bucket that comes with 4 medium sized bottles, peach and orange juices as well as strawberries for garnish. I tried the breakfast pizza and it was a full sized pizza! I had to share with my friends after eating only a slice & 1/2. Loud atmosphere but would come back for food & drinks.
Wasn't nearly as good last visit..... lets hope someone was off their game that visit

Just opened! It is located in shopping center where old Walmart was. It is right nextdoor to Dollar Tree. Bakery and sandwiches shop is being run by Raymond Bruno. Old  timers will remember his Father's wonderful restaurants. I stopped in yesterday and after sitting and  reminiscing with Raymond for 15 minutes, I  walked out with boxes and bags of goodies to try. I wasn't disappointed.  Bread, muffins, rolls even instore made bagels were marvelous.  
Great addition to northwest St Petersburg.

We placed a take out order last night.  We went to pick up and it was actually ready a few minutes early so we were hopeful to be off to a good start.  We get in the car and drive to where we were going to eat and enjoy the weather.  We start getting everything out and realize there is no cutlery or napkins in the bag.  The server at the restaurant said they were in there and we have nothing in the car.  We also realized at this point we were given corn muffins but had ordered biscuits...reconfirmed via email.  We head back to the restaurant to get this all corrected.  We stood there almost 15 minutes only waiting to get cutlery & biscuits?!  The server never apologized or offered any explanation.  We finally head out again back to our parking destination.  We start getting the food out.  One of the meals ordered was the fried chicken meal and was short a piece of chicken.  One of the sides with it was broccoli which was barely steamed and not even fresh.  The other order was for the sampler.  The piece of ham received was not much more than a sliver and contained more fat than meat.  What was supposed to be chicken and dumplings was mostly stale hardened dumplings with a single bite of chicken stuck in the middle of it.  Plus, all of the food was lukewarm at best or already cold since we had to wait 15 extra minutes just to get biscuits and cutlery.  Oh and to top it off... the biscuits were burnt!  In hindsight, we should have checked all the food over more closely before l

The Montecito burger is pretty good but the fries were way over cooked; I didn't eat most of them. My mom's fries were overcooked too and they were different than mine so maybe it was the person working the fryer that day? But since it's Covid we had already left to go eat at the beach. It would have been too much trouble to turn around and ask for fresh ones. That was disappointing for $31 dollars.

Visiting Santa Barbara for the weekend and stopped by Kanaloa for some of the best seafood I've ever had! We've eaten here twice in the last two days... It's THAT good! The first day I got a house salad (best beets ever ever had) with salmon and fish tacos (incredible!!). Day 2 we had a salmon burger and the ahi tuna poke. I'm pretty health conscious so the fact they make everything in house, with lots of gluten free options is big for me. I wish they had more shaded outdoor seating but the food is worth sitting in the sun for! Highly recommend!
Sorry to say the food wasn't up to standard. Loved it in the past, but after this experience won't order it again. Three stars is generous. Absolutely no effort put into the meal. Mediocre at best.
Burgers were poorly wrapped and tossed into the bag. The burgers were also poorly constructed. One of my patties was served RAW.
I ate here once with my daughter and found the dish to be very good. Friendly service and a clean environment but the parking is in back and tight.
This place is a must and has a cool vibe to go with it. Coffee and great and staff is awesome! Fun place to sit outside and enjoy friends with some quality coffee!

Amazing service and great food. Best service I have had in a very long time...Lola was awesome. Went on a Wednesday when they have some good specials, busy considering COVID restrictions but she still managed to provide menu recommendations, refills, and follow up.
Amazing food and service! Sat outside for a romantic evening. Best part of my stay in NO.

My wife wanted to try a different breakfast joint other than our usual and she picked The Barn. We were seated immediately, presented menus and asked what we would like to drink. Pretty standard protocol and off to a good start. We were asked if we wanted a mimosa or Bloody Mary , I declined and ordered a water and coffee while I looked at the menu. My wife asked for a mimosa and our server asked what kind and then proceeded with listing the different types they had available. She then ordered a mango mimosa and a water. We received our drinks and another server shortly after asked if we were ready to order and we said we needed a minute. A minute later a different server asked if we were ready to order, again we need a minute...this happened 4 times within about 5 min and then one of them informed us they work as a team. We had to go to the Eastside of Tucson and needed something to eat.  
Had a coupon, but when we got there they had a notice up about not providing discounts at this time.  
We decided to still go in and try them out.
Your classic little diner and we were the youngest in there. 
We noticed the name had changed by adding tavern....we were tempted to head on and check out the bar area, but decided it was best to have breakfast!!!!
Staff was very attentive, food was surprisingly good, and we are glad we stopped in.
It appeared they were providing take-out so paying for the check was a bit on the slow side.  
Wasn't too much of a problem- just make sure you aren't in a hurry.

COVID 19 safety protocol was they had hand sanitizer at front door, every other table was blocked off, staff wore masks, & whole place appeared very clean.
